insights.evidence: NPC batch (previous generation): only WTC CAAX clearly survived, F1 possibly — all other wells failed. Organoid plates started 23.06 (WTC, D1, Nr1) had to be discarded on 27.07 with severe dissociation, cells scattered far from the organoid core. Counter-example: David’s cells, where coating and medium were changed across different sequential splits, adapted and survived markedly better.
insights.topic: Staggered transitions when changing culture conditions
insights.insight: Changing the matrix coating AND the culture medium in the same split imposes lethal, cumulative stress — cells get no time to adapt to either change. Transitions must be staggered: change the coating at one split, then the medium at a later split (or vice versa).
